steps.message: Quantos chamados foram abertos em agosto de 2026 na praça Natal sem fornecedor?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND (supplier IS NULL OR BTRIM(supplier) = '');

SELECT ticket FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-08-01' AND created_on < '2026-09-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND (supplier IS NULL OR BTRIM(supplier) = '') ORDER BY ticket;
